challenge: Paired remote wrong-material painting locations with identical current legal observations and last-64 histories; distinct first legal repair actions, minimum 2-step suffix regret.
negative_results: Six out of 128 candidate worlds lacked a qualifying strict pair: five TRAIN and one DEV.
296 exact repeated TRAIN observations zero-weighted; not additional unique examples.
No actual model weights updated; no checkpoint inference metrics; no native CyberSand evaluation.
limitations: Synthetic graph host and static remote survey permit symbolic reconstruction.
Prelabel paint/intervention and 64+ drift movements scripted; suffixes oracle, not learned model rollouts.
Strict near-alias scenarios do not prove generalization to native CyberSand or exclude all grammar shortcuts.
Dataset shards not yet uploaded as immutable GitHub Actions artifact.
next_consumer_experiment: Pinned LFM2.5-350M or Sprocket-500M model training using TRAIN and DEV, fully closed-loop HELDOUT paired repair, full-history versus last64 versus survey-only; measure accuracy, realized regret, completion, residual wrong paint, illegal actions, actual latency p50/p95 and RSS.
